This beta adds a visual album artist overview alongside the album listening view
and the existing metadata editor.

## What's new

- **Album artists** in the sidebar opens cards with artist photos, names and album counts. Missing or unavailable photos fall back to initials.
- Search artist names and sort A–Z or Z–A. Results are paginated, including artists beyond the sidebar's first 200 matches.
- Choose a card to see all albums by that artist. This clears album search and filters for that navigation; the original sidebar navigation remains available.
- Browsing uses the existing album summaries without downloading track details. Changes to album artists and images are reflected when the library view updates.
- Album details, playback from a chosen track, automatic next track and **Edit album** from beta 1 remain available. Music keeps playing while browsing artists.
- Development credits acknowledge Claude (Anthropic) and ChatGPT / Codex (OpenAI).

## Testing

Download **Source code (zip)** below and unpack it into a separate folder next to
your working stable copy. Stop the running Tagcast server, then start the beta
with the usual start script. The page should show **0.9.0 beta 2**.

Check the new **Album artists** page, search, both sort directions, photos and
fallback initials. Open an artist's albums, start playback, return to the artist
grid and open the editor. Playback should continue while browsing.

The beta uses the same account settings folder as stable Tagcast unless you set
a separate `TAGCAST_HOME`. Your stable copy is not overwritten. Metadata saves
still require review; demo and imported libraries remain local previews. This
beta introduces no additional queue controls, shuffle, repeat or play reporting.

Stable 0.8.1 remains the latest stable release. Switch back by stopping the beta
server and starting your stable copy.
